blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.
blocks.zh: 科学论文等复杂文件在表格,数字和等式中包含丰富的信息;然而,现有的深入研究(DR)代理人通常会将论文减少为OCR所取出的案文. 相反,我们询问,视觉语言模型(VLMs)是否可以进行页内深入研究:直接检索和推理所制作的文件页图像。 我们引入了DR Pixel,这是第一个使用已渲染的页面图像作为唯一检索和推理单元的开源端到端多模式DR代理,运行于1.06M页的集合上. 为了评估这一设置,我们构建了DRPixel Bench,这是科学论文的基准,需要从文字、数字、表格和等式上进行推理。 出人意料的是,网页原生DR在未经培训的情况下已经取得了良好效果,在GPT-5.4,双子座-3.5-Flash,Qune3.6-27B等最先进的模型上表现优于基于OCR的基线,同时需要更少的工具呼叫. 我们接下来是DR训练。 一项关键的挑战在于,教师对代理制导微调的轨迹很吵,把批评推理和行动步骤与多余或失败的尝试相混合。 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了反事实信用再加权法,这是一种精细的信用分配方法,它通过个人推理和行动步骤对最终答案的反事实贡献进行加权。 我们的培训提高了大约15分的检索率,在DRPixel Bench上提高了10分以上的最后准确度,同样也超过了四个现有基准上未经培训的基线。 关于分配外的ViDoRe-V3, DR 像素在直接给予金页的甲骨文1.8分之内. 我们的结果表明,传统的OCR-当时的检索管道不仅没有必要,而且不尽人意:直接检索和对可视文件页的推理使复杂的DR既更有效又更有效率。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep research (DR) agents answer complex information-seeking questions by iteratively searching, reading, and reasoning over large collections of evidence ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Gemini, 2025 ; Li et al., 2025d ; Li et al., 2025a ) . As DR expands beyond the open web into domains such as law, finance, and science, it increasingly operates over specialized document collections ( Li et al., 2025b ; Choi et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . These documents are inherently multimodal: critical evidence often lies not only in text, but also in tables, figures, charts, and equations.
blocks.zh: 深度研究(DR)特工通过迭代搜索,阅读和推理大量收集证据来回答复杂的信息搜索问题(OpenAI,2025年;双子座,2025年;Li等人,2025年d;Li等人,2025年a). 随着DR从开放网络扩展到法律、金融和科学等领域,它越来越多地在专门的文献收集上运作(Li等人,2025年b;Choi等人,2026年;Xie等人,2025年b)。 2024; Chen等人,2025a;Chen等人,2025b). 这些文件本质上是多式的:关键证据不仅存在于文字中,而且存在于表格、数字、图表和方程式中。

blocks.en: Yet, such documents are typically reduced to plain text: PDFs are linearized into text, and retrieval and reasoning operate entirely in text space. This introduces two key limitations. First, linearization discards or distorts visual structure, making information in figures, tables, or charts difficult or impossible to recover ( Poznanski et al., 2025 ; Lo et al., 2023 ) . Second, extraction and OCR errors propagate into downstream retrieval and reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,这类文件通常被简化为纯文本: PDF被线性化成文本,检索和推理完全在文本空间中运行. 这提出了两个关键限制。 首先,线性化丢弃或扭曲视觉结构,使数字、表格或图表中的信息难以或无法恢复(Poznski等人,2025年;Lo等人,2023年)。 第二,提取错误和OCR错误传播到下游检索和推理中(Zhang等人,2025a); Wang et al., 2026 (英语).

blocks.en:
This raises a natural question: Can deep research instead be page-native, retrieving and reasoning directly over rendered document pages? In such an approach, each page remains an image: a visual retriever searches over rendered pages, and a vision-language model (VLM) reasons directly over the retrieved images.
Prior work has shown that such page-native retrieval can match or outperform text-based document retrieval ( Faysse et al., 2025 ; de Souza P. Moreira et al., 2026 ) , and has extended this approach to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tasks.
We study this approach in the deep research regime, where answering a query requires many rounds of retrieval and reasoning. To this end, we introduce DR Pixel , the first open-source page-native multimodal DR agent that iteratively searches and reasons directly over 1.06M rendered pages from scientific papers.
blocks.zh:
这自然提出了一个问题: 深层研究能否直接在已制作的文件页上进行页码、检索和推理? 在这样的做法中,每一页仍然是一幅图像:在所制作的网页上进行视觉检索,在所检索的图像上直接进行视觉语言模型(VLM)的检索。
先前的工作表明,这种页面内存检索可以匹配或超过基于文本的文件检索(Faysse等人,2025年;de Souza P. Moreira等人,2026年),并将这一办法扩大到检索的生成任务。
我们在深入研究制度中研究这一方法,在这种制度中,回答询问需要许多轮检索和推理。 为此,我们引入了DR Pixel,这是第一个开源的页面内涵多模式DR代理,通过科学论文直接在1.06M上进行迭代搜索和解释.

blocks.en:
The first challenge is evaluation:
existing DR benchmarks are either predominantly text-based ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Asai et al., 2024 ) or require relatively simple retrieval where a single search already achieves high recall ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Tanaka et al., 2023 ) .
To bridge this gap, we introduce DRPixelBench , comprising 500 500 questions over 1 1 M pages of scientific papers. It combines complex deep research queries that require long chains of retrieval and reasoning with the visual reasoning demands of scientific papers, such as interpreting experimental results in figures and tables.
Each question is grounded in a gold page and paired with a directly verifiable answer.
blocks.zh:
第一个挑战是评价:
现有的DR基准要么以文字为主(Chen等人,2026年;Xiong等人,2026年;Asai等人,2024年),要么要求比较简单的检索,只要一次搜索已经实现高召回(Wang等人,2025年a); Tanaka等人,2023年).
为了弥合这一差距,我们介绍了DRPixel Bench, 包括超过11M页的科学论文的500个问题。 它结合了复杂的深层研究查询,这些查询需要长链的检索和推理与科学论文的视觉推理要求,如在数字和表格中解释实验结果.
每个问题都以金页为基础,并配以可直接核实的答案。

blocks.en:
We then instantiate page-native deep research as an end-to-end VLM agent. DR Pixel indexes rendered pages directly with a VLM embedding model ( Li et al., 2026a ) , feeds retrieved images to the VLM agent, and maintains them as visual evidence throughout the trajectory, without ever being converted into plain text. The agent iteratively formulates queries, retrieves images, and reasons over evidence accumulated across turns to generate the final answer.
Our evaluation on DRPixelBench reveals a consistent advantage of page-native DR over OCR-based pipelines, even without targeted training: page-native DR improves accuracy by 5.1 5.1 – 8.4 8.4 points across GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Gemini-3.5-Flash ( Google, 2026 ) , and Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen, 2026 ) , while using 20 % 20\% – 30 % 30\% fewer retrieval calls than OCR-based pipelines.
blocks.zh:
然后我们即时进行网页内在的深度研究 作为终端到终端的VLM代理. 医生 像素索引直接用 VLM 嵌入模型(Li et al., 2026a)提供页面,将检索到的图像输入 VLM 代理,并在整个轨迹中将其作为视觉证据维护,而从未被转换成纯文本. 代理人迭代地提出询问,检索图像,以及跨回合积累的证据上的原因,以生成最终答案.
我们对于DRPixel Bench的评价显示,即使没有目标明确的训练,页面内源代码DR比基于OCR的管道有一贯的优势: page-native DR提高精度5.1 — 8.4 8.4分跨GPT-5.4(OpenAI, 2026),双子座3.5-Flash(Google, 2026),以及Quen3.6-27B(Quen, 2026),同时使用20% 20\% — 30% – 30\% 的检索通话比基于OCR的管道少.

blocks.en:
Still, the open-weight Qwen3.6-27B lags behind closed models (40.1 vs. 51.9), motivating us to train DR Pixel .
A key challenge is that demonstration traces for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) are often noisy, and are a mix of useful and unhelpful steps: some are critical to reaching the correct answers, while others are
redundant or failed attempts.
To account for this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting : a general recipe for DR training that weights each reasoning and action step by its contribution to the final answer.
For each step, we estimate its contribution by removing it from the trajectory and assigning higher training weight when its removal degrades answer quality.

不过开放量的Quen3. 6-27B 落后于封闭型号(40.1对5.19),
一个关键挑战是,监督微调(SFT)的演示痕迹往往很吵闹,是有用和无益的步骤的组合:有些步骤对于获得正确答案至关重要,而另一些步骤则十分关键。
重复或失败的尝试 。
为此,我们引入了反事实信用再加权法:一种DR培训的一般方法,它通过对最后答案的贡献来权衡每个推理和行动步骤。
对于每一步骤,我们估计其贡献,方法是将其从轨迹中去除,并在拆除后给予更高的训练重量,使其质量下降。

blocks.en: Our training method significantly improves the performance: with Qwen3.6-27B, it improves accuracy by 12.0 12.0 points ( 30 30 % relative) over the untrained model, and closes the gap to GPT-5.4. The gains also transfer beyond DRPixelBench : across three additional multimodal scientific literature benchmarks, our trained DR Pixel remains competitive and surpasses GPT-5.4 in retrieval on two of them. Notably, on the out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3 benchmark ( Loison et al., 2026 ) , the trained DR Pixel comes within 1.8 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练方法大大提高了性能:用Qwen3.6-27B,它比未经过训练的模型提高了12.0-12.0分(相对30-30%)的精度,并将差距拉近到GPT-5.4. 这些收益也超越了DRPixel Bench:通过另外三个多式科学文献基准,我们训练有素的DR Pixel仍然具有竞争力,并且超过了GPT-5.4对其中两个的检索。 值得注意的是,在ViDore-V3的分配外基准(Loison等人,2026年)上,受过训练的DR Pixel在直接获得金页的甲骨文1.81.8分范围内。

blocks.en: We summarize our key contributions as follows: 1. We introduce DR Pixel , a page-native deep research agent that treats papers as collections of rendered page images and iteratively retrieves and reasons over them. Across GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5, and Qwen3.6, DR Pixel consistently outperforms OCR-based models that convert papers to text. 2. We introduce a new DR training method, counterfactual credit reweighting , which weights each reasoning and search step in the training data by its contribution to the gold answer. It improves over the untrained model on all five benchmarks, and outperforms standard SFT. 3. We release DRPixelBench , consisting of complex questions that require both visual document understanding (e.g., analyzing results from tables and figures) and long chains of retrieval and reasoning, providing a challenging testbed for future work on deep research.
blocks.zh: 我们总结我们的主要贡献如下: 1. 我们介绍DR Pixel,这是一页内深层研究代理商,将论文视为已渲染的页面图像的集合,并反复检索这些图像及其理由。 通过GPT-5.4,双子座3.5,和Quen3.6,DR像素一致的超越了基于OCR的将纸张转换成文本的模型. 2. 我们采用了一种新的DR培训方法,即反事实信用再加权法,它通过对黄金答案的贡献,在培训数据中权衡每个推理和搜索步骤。 它改进了所有五个基准中未经培训的模型,并超过了标准SFT。 3. 我们释放了DRPixel Bench, 包括需要视觉文件理解(如分析表格和数字的结果)和长链检索和推理的复杂问题,为今后深入研究工作提供了具有挑战性的试验床。

blocks.en: We introduce DR Pixel , a page-native deep research agent that treats papers as collections of rendered page images and iteratively retrieves and reasons over them. Across GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5, and Qwen3.6, DR Pixel consistently outperforms OCR-based models that convert papers to text.

blocks.en: We introduce a new DR training method, counterfactual credit reweighting , which weights each reasoning and search step in the training data by its contribution to the gold answer. It improves over the untrained model on all five benchmarks, and outperforms standard SFT.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一种新的 DR 训练方法,反事实信用再加权。 它通过对黄金答案的贡献,在训练数据中权衡每个推理和搜索步骤。 它改进了所有五个基准中未经培训的模型,并超过了标准SFT。

blocks.en: We release DRPixelBench , consisting of complex questions that require both visual document understanding (e.g., analyzing results from tables and figures) and long chains of retrieval and reasoning, providing a challenging testbed for future work on deep research.
blocks.zh: 我们释放了DRPixel Bench(DRPixel Bench),其中包含复杂的问题,既需要视觉文档的理解(例如分析表格和数字的结果),也需要长链的检索和推理,为今后的深入研究工作提供了一个具有挑战性的测试床。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: DR agents tackle complex, multi-step information-seeking tasks through iterative search and synthesis ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025d ; Li et al., 2025c ; Shao et al., 2026 ) . Recent work extends the pipeline to multimodal deep research by adding tools such as image search, reverse image search or cross-modality retrieval ( Geng et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . Most of them focus on open web, where text and images are retrieved separately through two different search tools ( Tao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) . We instead target a collection of documents (e.g., scientific papers), where answering complex questions often requires jointly interpreting text, tables, and figures on the same page, making separate text and image retrieval interfaces suboptimal.
blocks.zh: DR代理通过迭代搜索和合成处理复杂、多步骤的信息搜索任务(姚等人,2023年;李等人,2025年d;李等人,2025年c;肖等人,2026年). 最近的工作通过增加图像搜索、反向图像搜索或跨模式检索等工具,将管道延伸至多式联运深入研究(Geng等人,2026年;姚等人,2026年)。 其中多数侧重于开放式网络,通过两个不同的搜索工具分别检索文本和图像(Tao等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年b; 蒋等, 2024 ). 相反,我们的目标是收集文件(例如科学文件),在这些文件中,回答复杂的问题往往需要在同一页上共同解释文本、表格和数字,使单独的文本和图像检索接口不尽人意。

blocks.en:
With rapid progress with vision-language models (VLMs), bypassing OCR pipelines and directly processing rendered document images has emerged as a promising direction ( Kim et al., 2022 ; Lee et al., 2023 ; Blecher et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) .
Building on this, visual document retrieval retrieves rendered pages directly, established by ColPali and followed by increasingly capable visual retrievers ( Faysse et al., 2025 ; Günther et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) .
More recent work extends this approach to further generate answers ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026 ) and add iterative retrieval ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . However, these settings require relatively shallow search, e.g., on ViDoSeek ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and SlideVQA ( Tanaka et al., 2023 ) , a single retrieval step already recalls the gold page in the top five for > 90 % >90\% of questions ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Giouroukis et al., 2025 ) . We instead study page-native deep research where complex queries require sustained search and reasoning over 10 10 – 20 20 steps.
blocks.zh:
随着视觉语言模型(VLMs)的迅速发展,绕过OCR管道和直接处理制成的文件图像已成为一个有希望的方向(Kim等人,2022年;Lee等人,2023年;Blecher等人,2024年;Wei等人,2026年)。
在此基础上,视觉文件检索可直接提供页面,由ColPali建立,随后是日益有能力的视觉检索器(Faysse等人,2025年;Günther等人,2025年;Li等人,2026a年)。
近期的工作将这一方法扩大到进一步生成答案(Yu等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a; Wang等人,2026年),并加入迭代检索(Wang等人,2025b; 沈等人著, 2026 ). 然而,这些设置需要比较浅的搜索,例如,在ViDoseek(Wang等人,2025a)和SlidVQA(Tanaka等人,2023年)上,一个单一的检索步骤已经回顾了前五位的黄金页 > 90% > 90%的问题(Wang等人,2025a;Giouroukis等人,2025年)。 相反,我们研究了网页上的深入研究,其中复杂的查询需要持续地进行搜索和推理,在10至20个步骤。

blocks.en:
Broadly, agents that generate long action trajectories are commonly trained with outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Shen et al., 2026 ) , sometimes with rubrics ( Shao et al., 2026 ) , or through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher-generated trajectories ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025a ) . Both provide limited credit assignment across a trajectory: outcome-based RL assigns a single reward to the rollout, and SFT imitates every teacher step regardless of its utility. Prior work has explored finer-grained supervision through process reward models that score each intermediate step ( Lightman et al., 2023 ) or by leveraging token- or step-level supervision coming from a teacher model conditioned on privileged context ( Meng and Chen, 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , both during RL.
In this paper, we propose an alternative approach that retains the simplicity of SFT: we reweight each agentic step by its counterfactual contribution to the final answer, estimated by removing the step and measuring the resulting change in answer quality.
blocks.zh:
广义地说,产生长动作轨迹的代理人通常接受基于结果的强化学习(RL)(Jin等人,2025年;Zheng等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年b;沈等人,2026年b)的训练,有时使用rucs(Shao等人,2026年),或通过监督微调(SFT)进行教师产生的轨迹(Chen等人,2023年;Li等人,2025年a年). 两者都提供有限的信贷分配,跨越一个轨道:基于成果的RL为推出提供单一的奖励,SFT模仿每个教师步骤,而不论其用途如何. 先前的工作探索了通过每个中间步骤评分的流程奖励模式(Lightman等人,2023年)或通过利用以特权背景为条件的教师模式(Meng and Chen, 2026年;Wu等人, 2026年)产生的象征性或步级监督(RL)进行精细的监管。
在本文中,我们提出了一个保留SFT的简单化的替代方法:我们通过对最后答案的反事实贡献来重新权衡每个代理步骤,通过去除该步骤和衡量由此产生的答案质量变化来估计。

blocks.en: 3 DRPixelBench
blocks.zh: 3个DRPixel奔驰

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks for complex information-seeking document collections largely fall into two categories: text-based DR benchmarks and multimodal document QA benchmarks ( Table 1 ).
Text-based deep research benchmarks evaluate iterative search and synthesis over large corpora, but often rely on templated questions ( Chen et al., 2026 ) or long-form answers that require nondeterministic, rubric-based evaluation ( Du et al., 2026 ; Asai et al., 2024 ) ; crucially, they are text-only.
Multimodal QA benchmarks instead require visual understanding from reports or scientific papers ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Tanaka et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Shorten et al., 2026 ; Loison et al., 2026 ) . However, their questions are often templated and require relatively shallow retrieval, with only one or a few steps needed to locate the relevant evidence.
blocks.zh:
用于收集复杂信息的文件的现有基准主要分为两类:基于文本的DR基准和多式联运文件QA基准(表1)。
基于文字的深度研究基准评价了对大蝎子的迭代搜索和合成,但往往依赖于模板化的问题(Chen等人,2026年)或需要非定型的,基于rumic的评价的长式答案(Du等人,2026年;Asai等人,2024年);关键是,它们只使用文字.
相反,多式联运质量保证基准需要从报告或科学论文中进行视觉理解(Ma等人,2024年;Tanaka等人,2023年;Wang等人,2025年a;Huang等人,2026年;Li等人,2024年;Shorten等人,2026年;Loison等人,2026年)。 然而,他们的问题往往被模板化,需要比较浅的检索,只需一个或几个步骤就可以找到相关的证据。

blocks.en: Table 1: DRPixelBench is the only benchmark combining iterative search over a large corpus ( Agentic ), multimodal evidence ( MM ), non-templated questions ( Non-templ. ), and verifiable short answers ( Verif. ).
blocks.zh: 表1:DRPixel Bench是将迭代搜索与大体(代理),多式联运证据(MM),非定时问题(非定时)和可核查的短答(Verif.)相结合的唯一基准。

blocks.en: We evaluate on four existing benchmarks (IRPAPERS, M3SciQA, AirQA, ViDoRe-V3) but argue that page-native DR requires a new benchmark, meeting four key properties: (1) agentic search , where relevant evidence typically requires multiple rounds of retrieval and reasoning; (2) multimodal evidence , where answers depend on text together with figures, tables, or equations; (3) non-templated questions , avoiding fixed schemas; and (4) short, verifiable answers , allowing direct evaluation against gold answers without relying on imperfect rubrics.
blocks.zh: 我们评价四个现有基准(IRPPERS、M3SciQA、AirQA、ViDoRe-V3),但认为,页式DR需要一个新的基准,满足四个关键属性:(1)代理搜索,而相关证据通常需要多轮检索和推理;(2)多式联运证据,其答案取决于文本以及数字、表格或方程;(3)非当代问题,避免固定的计数;(4)简短、可核查的答案,允许直接评价黄金答案,而不依赖于不完美的数字。

blocks.en: To this end, we build DRPixelBench over scientific literature. Scientific papers are naturally multimodal, with important information distributed across text, tables, figures, and equations.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们将DRPixel Bench建设在科学文献之上. 科学论文自然是多式的,重要信息分布在文字,表格,数字和方程式之间.

blocks.en: We collect papers from arXiv and the open-access proceedings of major conferences, and merge in the papers of AirQA ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , M3SciQA ( Li et al., 2024 ) and IRPAPERS ( Shorten et al., 2026 ) so that DRPixelBench and these three benchmarks share one corpus of 99,055 99{,}055 papers.
blocks.zh: 我们收集来自arXiv的论文和主要会议的公开查阅记录,并合并在AirQA(黄等人,2026年),M3SciQA(李等人,2024年)和IRPAPERS(肖滕等人,2026年)的论文中,这样DRPixel Bench和这三项基准共享了99 055 99{,}055份论文.

blocks.en:
Inspired by Dasigi et al. (2021) , we generate each question from a paper’s abstract rather than from its full text to keep it tied to the paper’s main contribution. As an abstract reports its findings with few supporting details, we first enrich it. Using Gemini-3.5-Flash ( Google, 2026 ) , we extract atomic facts from the full paper, such as a comparison in a table or a trend in a figure, and add them to the abstract. We then prompt the model to write a question from the enriched abstract alone, so that the question is driven by curiosity rather than by evidence already in view. We further ask the model to locate the supporting evidence in the full paper and produce a short-form answer. Depending on the form of this evidence, each question is labeled Text or Visual : a Text question is answered from the running text, while a Visual question requires a table, figure, or equation.
Each QA pair then undergoes four automatic checks to ensure that the question is plausible, the gold evidence is sufficient, non-textual evidence is necessary, and the answer cannot be recovered from parametric knowledge alone.
Finally, human experts review the question and rewrite it for naturalness.
The resulting DRPixelBench contains 500 500 QA pairs.
More details, including the data sources, parsing details, filter criteria, annotation details, and data statistics, are reported in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
在Dasigi等人(2021年)的启发下,我们从论文的抽象而非全文中提出每个问题,以保持与论文的主要贡献挂钩。 作为一个抽象的报告,我们首先用很少的佐证细节来充实其调查结果。 使用双子座-3.5-Flash(Google,2026年),我们从整篇论文中提取原子事实,如表格中的比较或图中的趋势,然后把它们加入抽象. 然后,我们促使模型从丰富的抽象中单独写出一个问题,这样,这个问题就是出于好奇而不是已经看到的证据。 我们还要求该模型在整份文件中找到佐证证据,并提出一个简短的答案。 根据这些证据的形式,每个问题都标注为Text或Visual :一个文本问题从运行的文本中解答,而Visual问题则需要表格,图,或方程.
然后每对QA进行四次自动检查,以确保问题可信,黄金证据充足,非文字证据是必要的,单凭参数化知识无法找到答案.
最后,人类专家审查这个问题,并将它改写为自然。
由此产生的DRPixel Bench包含500个500个QA对.
更多细节,包括数据来源、解析细节、过滤标准、注释细节和数据统计,见附录A。

blocks.en: We introduce DR Pixel : a deep research agent that uses rendered page images as both the retrieval unit and the model input. We describe our method ( Section 4.1 ) and present results showing that DR Pixel consistently outperforms OCR-based pipelines ( Table 2 ).

Formally, 𝒟 \mathcal{D} is a collection of parsed text documents, f f is a text retrieval model (e.g., a dense retrieval model ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) that indexes documents or text chunks into fixed-size vectors), and f ⁡ ( a t , 𝒟 ) f(a_{t},\mathcal{D}) returns text chunks most relevant to query a t . a_{t}. However, a key limitation of this design is the lossy conversion from documents to text ( Niu et al., 2026 ) .
Tables and equations may be parsed incorrectly; figures are often reduced to captions or omitted entirely; and OCR or parsing errors can corrupt even text content. Once discarded during parsing, this information cannot be recovered by downstream retrieval or reasoning.
blocks.zh:
然而,这一设计的一个关键限制是文件转换为文本的丢失(Niu等人,2026年)。
表格和方程式可能不正确解析;数字往往被简化为标题或完全省略;OCR或解析错误甚至可能腐蚀文本内容. 一旦在解析过程中被丢弃,则无法通过下游检索或推理来获取这些信息.

blocks.en: Some prior work mitigates this limitation by adding a second, image-retrieval tool and allowing the agent to choose between text and image search ( Suri et al., 2025 ) . However, this is still limited because text and visual content are treated as separate spaces without preserving relationships between them, e.g., a figure and the surrounding text that explains it. Moreover, information loss or corruption during text parsing still remains.
blocks.zh: 一些先前的工作通过增加第二个图像检索工具,并允许代理商在文本和图像搜索之间作出选择来减轻这一限制(Suri等人,2025年). 然而,这一点仍然有限,因为文本和视觉内容被作为单独的空间对待,而没有保留它们之间的关系,例如一个图和周围的文本来解释它. 此外,信息丢失或文本解析过程中的腐败依然存在。

blocks.en:
Our DR agent, DR Pixel , is an alternative instantiation of the DR agent in Equation 1 : it preserves the ReAct loop but replaces the search tool f f and its corpus 𝒟 \mathcal{D} to be image-based, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
Offline, each paper is rendered page by page, so 𝒟 \mathcal{D} becomes a collection of page images. Each image is encoded into a fixed-size vector using a VLM-based embedding model, e.g., Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B. At inference time, f f maps a text query a t a_{t} into the same embedding space and returns the top- k k page images.
These images are passed directly to the agent π , \pi, which is itself a VLM. The agent reasons over those images and generates the next thought τ t + 1 \tau_{t+1} and action a t + 1 , a_{t+1}, repeating this process until it produces a final answer.

blocks.en:
Although Qwen3.6-27B issues a similar number of retrieval calls to GPT-5.4, it trails by 11.8 11.8 points in accuracy under DR Pixel setting. As shown in Table 3 , we decompose this gap into retrieval and reasoning. In retrieval, Qwen3.6-27B retrieves the gold page 9.4 9.4 points less often, and its searches are less productive with 5.3 % 5.3\% of its queries duplicate an earlier one and 21.6 % 21.6\% of its trajectories contain at least one duplicate. In reasoning, Qwen3.6-27B struggles to use pages retrieved earlier in the trajectory. When the gold page comes from the latest search, it trails GPT-5.4 by only 5.1 5.1 points, but the gap widens to 12.3 12.3 when the page was retrieved in an earlier search.
This motivates training an open-weight model, as described in Section 5 .

blocks.en: 5 DR Pixel Training
blocks.zh: 5 DR 像素训练

blocks.en: Having shown that page-native DR improves performance even without training, we next train DR Pixel to further improve its capabilities. We denote the untrained model as DR Pixel Base {}_{\text{Base}} and the trained model as DR Pixel Trained {}_{\text{Trained}} . We first describe the training method ( Section 5.1 ), then present the main results ( Section 5.2 ) and ablations ( Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在表明页面本地化DR即使没有培训也能提高性能之后,我们下火车DR像素进一步提高能力. 我们表示未经训练的模型为 DR Pixel Base { text{Base{} 和经过训练的模型为 DR Pixel Trained { text{Trained} 。 我们首先介绍培训方法(第5.1节),然后介绍主要结果(第5.2节)和模拟(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Training Method
blocks.zh: 5.1 培训方法

blocks.en: We train DR Pixel with supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We sample trajectories from GPT-5.4 on training questions generated using the same pipeline as § 3 , but without human rewriting or verification; and use them as training data.
blocks.zh: 我们用有监督的微调来训练Pixel博士 我们从GPT-5.4中抽样研究使用与§3相同的管道生成的培训问题的轨迹,但不进行人文改写或核实;并将轨迹用作培训数据。

blocks.en:
However, we find standard SFT has a problem because the trajectories in the training data often contain repeated or low-value searches that do not contribute to the final answer.
Naively imitating these unhelpful steps encourages excessive searching and inefficient use of the retrieval budget. Inspired by process rewards, which assign credit to individual intermediate steps ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Setlur et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , we instead weight each step by its contribution to the final answer. Specifically, our counterfactual credit reweighting removes each step from a fixed teacher trajectory and measures the resulting drop in the gold-answer likelihood under the frozen base model, assigning higher weight to steps that are more consequential.
blocks.zh:
然而,我们发现标准SFT有一个问题,因为训练数据中的轨迹往往包含重复或低值搜索,这些搜索无助于最终答案.
自然模仿这些无益的步骤会鼓励过度搜索和无效使用检索预算. 受过程奖励的启发,为个别中间步骤分配功劳(Lightman等人,2024年;Setlur等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2024年;Zhou等人,2025年),我们转而通过对最后答案的贡献来权衡每一步骤。 具体地说,我们的反事实信用再加权将每个步骤从固定的教师轨迹中去掉,并测量在冻结的基数模型下产生的金子解答可能性的下降,对更具有后果的步数赋予更高的权重.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Deep research over complex documents typically begins with OCR. DR Pixel instead performs retrieval and reasoning directly over rendered pages. We study this setting with DRPixelBench , containing 500 500 verifiable questions over 1.06 1.06 M pages of scientific literature, and show that page-native deep research consistently outperforms OCR-based pipelines across all tested models while using fewer tool calls, even without task-specific training. To close the remaining gap for open-weight models, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting , which weights teacher steps by their contribution to the gold answer and brings a 27 27 B model to GPT-5.4-level accuracy with lower search cost. These gains transfer to external benchmarks and non-scientific documents. More broadly, page-native deep research requires only document rendering rather than format-specific parsing, making it particularly attractive for private, layout-rich corpora such as financial or law documents where maintaining OCR and parsing pipelines is costly and brittle.

blocks.en: All three corpora take the same PDFs as input and differ only in the retrieval unit they produce. Training runs for one epoch at a constant learning rate of 1 ​ e − 4 1\mathrm{e}{-4} with an effective batch size of 16 16 , from four H200 GPUs at one sequence per device and four gradient-accumulation steps. blocks.en: Counterfactual credits are computed offline against the frozen base policy at two forward passes per step and written into the training file as a per-message weight. Each assistant message is split at the boundary between its reasoning and its action so the two channels can carry different weights, and the trainer multiplies each message’s token loss by its weight. The training step is therefore ordinary supervised fine-tuning at no extra cost, and the whole method sits in data preparation. Observation tokens are excluded from the loss in every arm.
blocks.zh: 反事实信用额根据冻结的基数政策按每步两次前置通行证计算,并按每个消息的权重写入培训档案。 每个助理消息在它的推理和它的动作的边界上被分割,这样两个渠道可以携带不同的权重,教练员将每个消息的符号损失乘以其权重. 因此,培训步骤是普通的有监督的微调,不增加费用,整个方法都用于数据编制。 观察标志不包括在每一臂的损失中。

blocks.en: Training questions come from the same pipeline as the benchmark, taken before human annotation, over a disjoint pool of papers, and no paper supporting a training question supports an evaluation question. blocks.en: Masking every step of non-positive credit zeroes about a quarter of the steps and leaves the mean weight roughly a third below the uniform baseline, so the weighted run effectively takes smaller optimisation steps, and a constant factor on all weights is equivalent to a change of learning rate. Restoring the mean to the baseline settles this: accuracy given the gold page falls from 68.7 68.7 to 63.1 63.1 , the largest reading loss in the family, while the number of searches barely moves.
blocks.zh: 遮盖每一步非正积分零大约四分之一的步数,平均重量大约比统一基线低三分之一,因此加权运行有效采取较小的优化步骤,所有加权的恒定因子相当于学习率的变化. 恢复基线的平均值就解决了这一问题:黄金页的准确性从68.7 68.7降至63.1 63.1, 这是家族中最大的阅读损失,而搜索次数几乎没有移动。

blocks.en: A counterfactual credit is larger on hard questions, where deleting any step moves the likelihood of the gold answer substantially, so ranking against the whole training set imports question difficulty into a step-level signal. The effect is measurable: the mean surviving weight of a trajectory ranges from 0.65 0.65 at the tenth percentile to 1.70 1.70 at the ninetieth, so a step’s weight depends substantially on which trajectory it belongs to. We also try ranking a step only against the other steps of its own trajectory, and only against the steps of the same question’s rollouts. Both remove the leak, because a step is then never compared with a step from a different question. Neither helps: within-trajectory ranking stays on par with the reference (50.1 vs. 50.9) and within-question ranking is 2.3 points lower, so the bias is real but harmless.
blocks.zh: 在硬问题上反事实信用更大,删除任何步骤都会大大移动金子解答的可能性,因此相对于整个训练的排名会将进口困难问题放入一步级信号中. 效果是可衡量的:轨迹的平均存活重量从10百分位的0.65 0.65到第90位的1.70 1.70不等,因此一个步骤的重量在很大程度上取决于它属于哪个轨迹。 我们还试图只比照自身轨迹上的其他步骤, 两者都去除漏水,因为一个步骤从此从不与另一个问题的一个步骤相比. 也无济于事:弹射内排位与参考(50.1 vs 50.9)保持同等水平,问题内排位降低2.3分,因此偏差是真实的但无害的.

blocks.en: Equal mean weights do not equalise what a trajectory contributes: its total weighted mass spans a factor of about six between the tenth and ninetieth percentiles, since a long or lightly masked trajectory supplies far more weighted tokens. Equalising that mass is the most aggressive variant we tried and the weakest result, five points below the reference. This is because a light trajectory gets multiplied by a large ratio.
blocks.zh: 相等的平均权重并不等于轨迹的贡献:其总加权质量在第十百分位和第九百分位之间大约为六倍,因为长长或轻薄的轨迹能提供更加权的标志。 平衡质量是我们尝试过的最具有攻击性的变体,也是最弱的结果,低于参考文献的五点。 这是因为轻轨乘以大比例。

blocks.en: Numerical calibration is thus not where the credit acts. Rescaling the weights either does nothing or degrades reading, and changing the support of the rank does nothing at all. What remains is which steps the credit masks and how that mask is distributed along a trajectory.
blocks.zh: 因此,信用行为地点不是数字校准。 调整权重要么无济于事,要么贬低阅读,改变军衔的支持完全无济于事. 剩下的是什么 步调 信用面具 和如何分配 沿着一个轨道。

We ask what the two models do differently at inference, and what in the loss produces it.

blocks.en: Figure 8 plots the share of questions still searching after k k calls. The curves separate at once and never cross: by the fifth search DR Pixel Trained {}_{\text{Trained}} has finished a third of its questions and vanilla SFT almost none. Per step, averaged over the first twelve searches, DR Pixel Trained {}_{\text{Trained}} stops with probability 10.2 % 10.2\% , close to the untrained backbone’s 9.4 % 9.4\% and GPT-5.4’s 8.9 % 8.9\% , while vanilla SFT stops with probability 4.4 % 4.4\% . At that rate the expected trajectory is 22.8 22.8 searches, longer than the budget allows, so the cap is what ends a third of its trajectories.
blocks.zh: 图8绘制了在 kk 呼叫后仍然搜索的问题份额。 曲线瞬间分开,永不交叉:通过第五次搜索 DR Pixel Trained QQText{Trained {已经完成了三分之一的问题,香草SFT几乎全无. 每个步骤, 平均在前12次搜索中, DR Pixel Trained QQText{Trained}} 以概率 10.2% 10.2\% 止步, 接近未训练骨干9.4% 9.4\% 和 GPT-5.4 的 8.9% 8.9\% , 而 Vanilla SFT 则以概率 4.4 % 4.4\% 止步 。 以这个速度计算,预期的轨迹是22.8 22.8次搜索,比预算允许的要长,所以上限是其轨迹的三分之一。

blocks.en: The credit is much harsher on reasoning than on search. As shown in Figure 7 , it masks 62.6 % 62.6\% of reasoning steps but only 24.5 % 24.5\% of search steps. Only search reacts to trajectory length: almost nothing is masked on trajectories with a single search, 0.2 % 0.2\% , against 40.2 % 40.2\% on trajectories that reach the budget, while reasoning stays between 51 % 51\% and 68 % 68\% whatever the length. The small slope reasoning does have is borrowed, since the cross-channel correction of Section 5.1 masks a reasoning step whenever its query is masked. Length is therefore handled by the search channel: longer trajectories lose a larger share of their search steps, which is how the credit offsets the length bias, and reasoning follows along.
blocks.zh: 在推理方面,功劳比搜索要严厉得多。 如图7所示,它掩盖了62.6%的推理步骤,但只有24.5%的搜索步骤。 只有搜索对轨迹长度做出反应:在轨迹上几乎没有任何东西被遮掩,只有0.2%. 0.2%.,而在达到预算的轨迹上几乎是40.2%. 40.2%. 2%.,而推理则停留在51%. 51%.和68%. 68. 任何长度. 小型坡度推理的确被借用,因为跨通道修正第5.1节掩盖了每当其查询被掩盖时的推理步骤. 因此长度由搜索通道处理:较长的轨迹会失去他们搜索步骤的更大份额,这就是信用如何抵消长度偏差,推理随之而来.

blocks.en: In each trajectory we locate the first search that returns a page the final answer cites, and measure the mask rate at each position relative to it. That search is almost never masked, 2.5 % 2.5\% of the time, while every other search is masked between 15 % 15\% and 42 % 42\% . Among the steps that survive it also carries the largest weight, 1.25 1.25 , against 0.7 0.7 to 0.8 0.8 for searches a few steps later. Reasoning peaks one step further on, at 1.21 1.21 . This position is never supplied to the method, so the pattern is emergent. Because almost every step the credit removes is issued after the evidence is already in context, the pruning suppresses continuation rather than retrieval, which is why the search count falls while the page hit rate does not.
blocks.zh: 在每一轨迹中,我们找到第一个返回一页的搜索,最后的答案引用,并测量相对于每一位置的遮罩率。 搜索几乎从未蒙面, 2.5% 2.5 +%的时间, 而所有其他搜索都蒙面 15% +% 和 42% 42 +% 之间。 在幸存下来的步骤中,1.251.25的重量也最大,0.7至0.8的搜索在之后几步。 造成高峰后一步,在1.21.21。 这个位置从不供给给方法,所以模式出现. 因为几乎每个移除的信用步骤都是在证据已经存在上下文后发布的,所以普鲁因抑制了续作而不是检索,这就是为什么搜索计数下降,而页面点击率却没有.
